transactions.counterparty: Changsha 2023 Consulting & Management Co., Ltd. (indirect wholly owned subsidiary of CapitaLand Mall Asia Limited)
transactions.sale_price_citation: 'The divestment was completed on 31 October 2025 at a sale price of RMB813.8 million.'
transactions.citation: p97 Audited Distribution Statement note: divested 'at a premium over the valuation as at 31 December 2024'; p28/p102 Consolidated Portfolio Statement: appraised value RMB785.0m as at 31 Dec 2024; divestment narrative p37: sale price RMB813.8m
transactions.notes: PROPERTY-LEVEL premium (per spec): (RMB813.8m sale price - RMB785.0m Dec-2024 valuation) / RMB785.0m = +3.67%, computed in the property's local currency (RMB) since sale price and valuation are both RMB-denominated on the Portfolio Statement. This is a subsidiary (SPV) disposal, so a SEPARATE accounting loss is also reported: 'loss on disposal of subsidiaries' of S$(11,988)k (Statement of Total Return, p95), struck against net assets disposed of S$142,300k (net-identifiable-assets basis, cash-flow Note B pp103-104), not against this property-level valuation. That accounting loss largely reflects realised FX differences on divestment of the RMB-denominated SPV, not an economic discount to valuation. Net cash inflow on divestment of subsidiary: S$131,644k.
